14a_1_hidden_coordinate.png: Left: the hidden coordinate $y = \ln|\sin z|/(6H)$ against $z = 6Hx_0$ (radians) over one cell $0 < z < \pi$ for $H = 1$; the two shaded halves meet at the fold $z = \pi/2$ (dashed line), where $y = 0$, and on each half $y$ falls to minus infinity at the tip ($\sin z \to 0$); the reflection $z \to \pi - z$ maps one half onto the other and keeps $y$. Right: the warp $e^{Hy}$ of the extra-time scale factors (solid), the factor $(\sin^2 z)^{1/6} = e^{2Hy}$ of the extra-time entries (dashed) and the volume factor $e^{3Hy}$ of $\sqrt{|g|} = e^{-a_4}b_4^2e^{3Hy}$ (dotted) against $y$ from $-3$ to $0$ in units of $1/H$, on a logarithmic vertical axis; the straight lines have the slopes 1, 2 and 3, and the proper volume near the tip is smaller than at the fold by the factor $e^{-9}$.
14a_2_inflation_deflation.png: Left: along the prescribed history $a_4 = A H x_4$, $b_4 = b_4(0)e^{(4/3)AHx_4}$ with $A = H = 1$, $b_4(0) = 1$, against $a_4$: the 3-space scale factor $e^{a_4}$ (solid) grows, the extra-time scale factor at the fold and the hidden scale $f = e^{-a_4}b_4^{1/2} = e^{-a_4/3}$ (dashed) shrink together, the momentum weight $\kappa = e^{-a_4}$ (dash-dotted) shrinks faster, and the proper 7-volume of a coordinate cell $e^{-a_4}b_4^2 = e^{(5/3)a_4}$ (dotted) grows; logarithmic vertical axis. Right: at the five slices $a_{4,0} = 0$ to $2$, the extra-time scale factor $fe^{Hy}$ (solid lines, slope 1 in $y$) and the momentum weight $\kappa = e^{-a_{4,0}}$ (dotted horizontal lines, the same at every $y$) against $y$ in units of $1/H$: only the extra times carry the warp, and every later slice lies lower.
14a_3_spin_connection_terms.png: The contribution of each direction $\mu$ to $\gamma^\mu\Omega_\mu$, written as $c_4\gamma^{(x_4)} + c_0\gamma^{(x_0)}$, on the prescribed history ($a_4' = 1$, $b_4'/b_4 = 4/3$, $H = 1$) at the first slice ($a_4 = 0$, $b_4 = 1$, so $f = 1$): left bar of each pair $c_4$, right bar $c_0$, in units of $H$. The hidden direction $x_0$ gives $h_4/2 = -1/6$ with $h_4 = b_4'/(2b_4) - a_4'$; each 3-space direction gives $a_4'/2 = 1/2$; each extra time gives $h_4/2 = -1/6$ and $H/(2f) = 1/2$; the time $x_4$ gives nothing. In total $\gamma^\mu\Omega_\mu = (3/2)(H/f)\gamma^{(x_0)} + (b_4'/b_4 - a_4'/2)\gamma^{(x_4)} = (3/2)\gamma^{(x_0)} + (5/6)\gamma^{(x_4)}$.
14a_4_block_structure.png: Absolute values of the matrix entries (row and column 0 to 15, darker is larger) of the first-order matrix $N_{16}$ of the stationary equation $\chi' = fN_{16}\chi$ at $M = 1$, $\varepsilon = 0.5$, $v = 0$, $\kappa k = 0.7$: left in the original spinor basis, where the entries are spread over the matrix; middle in the block basis $V$, where only the eight $2\times2$ blocks on the diagonal are nonzero (thin lines mark the blocks); right the chirality matrix $\Gamma$ in the block basis, which connects each block $(j, s_2, s_3)$ with the block $(-j, s_2, s_3)$ four positions away.
14a_5_rescaling.png: The exact rescaling identity. Left: the momenta of the first six lattice shells, $|\mathbf{k}| e^{-a_{4,0}}$ with $|\mathbf{k}| = 0.25\sqrt{n^2}$ (units of $H$), against the slice $a_{4,0}$ from 0 to 2 on a logarithmic vertical axis: parallel straight lines, every 3-momentum is redshifted by the same factor $e^{-a_{4,0}}$. Right: the parameters of the partner problem at the first slice ($H = 1$, $L = 3$, $\Delta k = 0.25$, $v_t = 1$ on the history $b_4 = e^{(4/3)a_4}$): $He^{a_{4,0}/3}$, $Le^{-a_{4,0}/3}$, $\Delta k\,e^{-a_{4,0}}$ and $v_te^{-a_{4,0}}$ (lines) with the values of the Revision record rescaling.csv at the slices 0.5 to 2 (dots); logarithmic vertical axis.
